Self-improving universal agent for skill evolution:

- Introduced multi-memory architecture (semantic, episodic, and working memory) to track and learn from all skill executions.

- Added structured experience extraction, feedback integration, and reusable pattern abstraction for continuous self-improvement.
- Auto-triggers on skill completion and errors to update knowledge and evolve skill guidance.
- Prioritizes improvements using an evolution priority matrix to keep skills up-to-date with new insights.
